Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

LEFT: ONE real adult Iranian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, richly kohl-lined almond eyes, a deep berry-red lip, thick dark brows, warm olive skin, cool ash-brown hair styled in a short pixie cut, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large bronze hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a gold hammer head, a silver ship's anchor, a silver pyramid-shaped lump), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long bronze chain ending in one large faceted sapphire drop with a heavy rough lead a small flared temple bell hanging at its end, and two to three gold hair ornaments.
